cues: At the O H bond, reactive metals like sodium replace the hydrogen, giving sodium ethoxide and hydrogen gas.
But compare with water: sodium reacts violently with water and only steadily with ethanol.
Alcohols are weaker acids than water.
Primary alcohols react fastest and tertiary slowest, because extra alkyl groups push charge onto the oxygen of the alkoxide ion and destabilise it.
text: At the O H bond, reactive metals like sodium replace the hydrogen, giving sodium ethoxide and hydrogen gas. Aluminium does the same. But compare with water: sodium reacts violently with water and only steadily with ethanol. Alcohols are weaker acids than water. Primary alcohols react fastest and tertiary slowest, because extra alkyl groups push charge onto the oxygen of the alkoxide ion and destabilise it.
